origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi glose 筋 « force de la chair » et le compose de 力, la force, de 肉, la chair, écrite 月, et de 竹, le bambou. Il explique que le bambou est la plante qui a le plus de fibres. Les fibres qui font la force du muscle : le tendon, 筋骨.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi glosses 筋 as “the strength of flesh” and builds it from 力, strength, 肉, flesh, written 月, and 竹, bamboo. It explains that bamboo is the plant with the most fibres. The fibres that give a muscle its strength: tendons, 筋骨.
